Application Materials.content:
Please upload supporting documents as a PDF onto the [Graduate Admission System](https://gradapp.nus.edu.sg/portal/app_manage). The total size of uploaded documents should not exceed **10MB**. Documents not in English must be accompanied with certified copies of the English-translated version. Incomplete applications will not be considered. **You do not need to mail any documents during the application stage.** **Letters of recommendation, reference letters and referee details are not required to be submitted.**
- Your resume: updated resume detailing educational background, internship and work experience (if any), achievements, etc.
- Copy of your official identification documents: international applicants submit a copy of passport identification page.
- Certified copies of your transcripts/mark sheets and degree certificate. Official transcripts and attested copy of degree scroll will be required after you are offered a place in the programme. Transcript Request Forms are available via this [link](https://msgfin.nus.edu.sg/wp-content/uploads/sites/90/2022/09/Transcript-Request-Form.pdf).
- A Letter of Motivation: _Not more than 500 words_.
- GMAT/GRE scores (optional): GMAT score recipient is **“National University of Singapore” (GMAT Code: DRT-MK-96 MSc in Marketing Analytics and Insights)**; GRE score recipient is **“4642 – NUS Business School MSc Programmes”**.
- TOEFL / IELTS scores (if applicable): upload a softcopy of your IELTS Test Report Form via the application portal; upload a softcopy of your TOEFL Score Report via the application portal and indicate institution code **“0677 National University of Singapore”**.
If offered admission, official transcripts must be sent by the institution / university in a sealed envelope with its flap bearing the security seal of the institution / university directly to: MSc Programmes Office, Mochtar Riady Building Level 2, 15 Kent Ridge Drive, Singapore 119245.

Interview Requirements.content: A strong performance in the interview (conducted for shortlisted candidates only).

Academic Requirements.content:
- **NUS MSc in Marketing Analytics and Insights + CEMS MIM programme:** A good undergraduate degree in business or a business-related discipline.
- **Work Experience (Not Required):** We do not require you to have work experience for admission into the programme. Applicants with some postgraduate work experience are also welcome to apply.

GRE GMAT Requirements.content:
**GMAT/GRE scores are optional**. Though it is not mandatory, a good GMAT or GRE score may enhance your application, particularly if your academic performance does not fully reflect your potential. Double degree programme applicants also stand a higher chance of getting their preferred placement in CEMS host schools.
**Our institution code for this programme:**
- GMAT institution code: DRT-MK-96 (MSc in Marketing Analytics and Insights)
- GRE institution code: 4642 – NUS Business School MSc Programmes
[More info on GMAT/GRE](https://mscmarketing.nus.edu.sg/faqs/)

English Proficiency Requirements.content:
#### **English Language Requirement**
If English is not the native language or medium of prior undergraduate instruction. For **TOEFL**, the internet-based test score must be at least **5.0**. For **IELTS**, the overall band score must be at least **7.0**.
#### **CEMS Language Requirements**
Besides good oral and written skills in English, applicants for the double-master degree programme with CEMS must be proficient in at least one other CEMS language. Click [here](https://mscmarketing.nus.edu.sg/admissions/admission-requirements/#) for common CEMS application requirements.

Program Overview.content:
The CEMS Master in International Management (MIM) is a strategic global alliance of [leading business schools](https://www.cems.org/academic-members/school-list), [multinational companies](https://www.cems.org/corporate-social-partners/cems-corporate-partners) and [non-governmental organisations](https://www.cems.org/corporate-social-partners/cems-social-partners) coming together to offer a unique pre-experience master’s programme. As a proud member of this alliance, NUS Business School provides our students exceptional international opportunities. This highly-ranked, global, one-year, pre-experience MIM programme emphasises and develops management and leadership competencies with an emphasis on internationalism and responsible leadership.
**Programme benefits**
- **Global Exposure:** Study across **two world-class institutions** with a mandatory international internship and exclusive global skill seminars.
- **Dual Qualification:** Specialise in Marketing Analytics & International Management.
- **Elite Network:** Join a selective community of high-achieving graduates across **33 countries** with lifelong access to the CEMS alumni network.
- **Corporate Connections:** Engage directly with **multinational corporate partners** through exclusive recruitment events, business projects and mentorship opportunities.
| Year 1 | Year 2 |
| --- | --- |
| Semester 1: Aug – Dec, 5 MSc in Marketing Courses (20 Units)* | Semester 1: Aug – Dec, CEMS Block Seminar (3 ECTS), CEMS Compulsory Course: Global Strategy (6 ECTS), 3 Courses (18 ECTS)**, Skills Seminar |
| Semester 2: Jan – May, 4 MSc in Marketing Courses (16 Units)* | Semester 2: Jan – May, CEMS Compulsory Course: Global Leadership (6 ECTS), CEMS MIM Course (6 ECTS), CEMS Business Project (15 ECTS), Skills Seminar, CEMS Global Citizenship Seminar (1 ECTS) |
| Special Term: May – Jul, Credit-bearing Internship (MAI and CEMS Requirement) (4 units) | |
| NUS | CEMS Partner University / NUS |
| **Total: NUS MSc in MAI (40 Units) + CEMS MIM (66 ECTS) + Internship** | |
* 2 [MAI courses](https://mscmarketing.nus.edu.sg/academics/) (8 units/12 ECTS) will be used to map to meet CEMS Requirement. At NUS, the workload of each course is expressed in terms of Units. The European equivalent of workload representation is ECTS credits. A typical course consists of 4 Units (or 6 ECTS), representing about 10 hours of work per week.
**What CEMS MIM Offers**
- **International Exchange Programme:** You are required to spend one term at a CEMS partner school. Destination for the term abroad will depend on availability. Location and sequence preferences will be taken into consideration, but those with better academic standing (including good GMAT scores) may stand a higher chance of getting their preferred placement.
- **Block Seminar:** You will begin the CEMS MIM term with a mandatory intensive one-week Block Seminar that is an ideal start to the programme as it facilitates discussion of management topics from different cultural and academic perspectives.
- **Unique Global Courses:** You will have to successfully complete exclusive CEMS courses such as Global Strategy, Global Leadership and Global Citizenship. The Global Citizenship Seminar is a two-day course that brings together representatives from corporate and / or social partners, professors and students to have the opportunity to engage with the UN Sustainable Development Goals through experiential learning.
- **Skills Seminars:** These shorter seminars provide training on a wide variety of essential and practical skills for an effective professional career. They are held throughout the two terms and are often in cooperation with corporate organisations.
- **CEMS Business Project:** Adopting a consultancy-like approach, you will work in small teams and apply your skills and knowledge to solve a real business problem for an international organisation. Your student team will work independently and will be supervised and evaluated by both your faculty advisor and the corporate representatives. The Business Project will amount to about half of Semester 2’s workload.
- **International Internship:** The objective of this internship is to turn academic and theoretical knowledge into a professional and multi-cultural experience. Your internship can take place at a CEMS Corporate Partner, an international company, or a non-profit organisation, as long as the company operates in an international environment, and your work responsibilities correspond to that of a new graduate hire.
- **Global Network:** As part of the CEMS network, you will have the opportunity to interact with a truly international team, benefiting from the great diversity of your peers, our professors, and our alumni.

Cost of Attendance.content:
The estimated monthly living expenses* for an international student in Singapore are outlined below:
| Expense Type | Cost |
| --- | --- |
| Accommodation | [On-campus housing](https://www.nus.edu.sg/osa/student-services/hostel-admission/graduate/hostel-options) (subject to availability) S$900 – S$1,800; Renting a room in a public housing apartment S$700 – S$1,000; Renting a room in a private apartment S$1,000 – S$2,000; Renting a 3-bedroom private apartment S$4,000 onward |
| Meals | S$300 – S$800 |
| Transport (within Singapore) | S$80 – S$200 (buses and trains) |
| Healthcare | S$52 – S$112 per consultation with a General Practitioner |
| Personal Expenses | S$200 – S$350 |
| Mobile phone & broadband subscription | S$98 – S$280 |
*Actual amounts will vary, depending on the individual’s lifestyle, but you should budget a minimum of **S$19,500 per year** for living expenses in Singapore. Sources: [EDB Singapore and NUS Hostel](https://www.edb.gov.sg/en/setting-up-in-singapore/cost-of-living-calculator.html) & [Meal Plan Rates](http://nus.edu.sg/osa/housing/graduate/hostel-and-meal-plan-rates.html)

Financial Aid.content:
Limited **full scholarships** & **study awards** are available for selected outstanding applicants. Study awards will cover a portion of the programme fees. There is no need to apply separately for study awards or scholarships; however, candidates must submit an application by the [first cut-off date](https://mim.nus.edu.sg/fees-finances/awards/). Study award and scholarship recipients are chosen based on merit in the following categories:
- **Excellence**: This study award is given to outstanding candidate(s) who have done exceptionally well in their academics, as well as during the application process (e.g. interviews).
- **Diversity**: This study award is given to outstanding candidate(s) who come from diverse personal and professional backgrounds and experience, and can contribute to the overall experience of their cohort.
- **Resilience**: This study award is given to outstanding candidate(s) who have demonstrated determination and resilience to achieve excellence in spite of adversity and hardship.
- **Achievers**: This study award is given to outstanding candidate(s) who have achievements in activities outside of the classroom, e.g. promoting or contributing to the UN SDGs; community service in social, environment, or other sectors; entrepreneurship, etc.
- **Local Candidates**: This study award is given to outstanding candidate(s) who are Singaporeans or Singapore PRs.
- **ASEAN Candidates**: This study award is given to outstanding candidate(s) who are nationals of an ASEAN country.
- **NUS Alumni**: This study award is given to outstanding candidate(s) who are NUS Alumni.

Multiple Applications.content:
Applicants are allowed to apply to multiple programmes based on interest. However, you can only enrol in one programme. For applicants who are undecided, I recommend submitting multiple applications. This would give you more choices and may increase your probability of admission. Applications for different programmes are reviewed by different admissions committees, and they have no impact on each other. As such, you may want separately prepare your application for each programme to best emphasise your fit for a programme. Also, please note that each application would incur a separate application fee.
If you apply for multiple programmes within the same application period, please create all applications, as shown on the page below, and rank them in order of preference. Please note that they cannot be modified after submission. Your preferences will only be considered if you are applying to multiple programmes offered by the same School, Faculty or College. As your preferences cannot be changed after submission of application, please finalise your order of preference before submitting your application (i.e. when the Application Status is at “Pending online submission”). As mentioned earlier, your preference will not be a consideration if you are applying for programmes offered by different Departments or Schools.
